groups.activity: finish The Archwing and clear the Jupiter to Europa Junction

rows.label: The Archwing, then build the Odonata
Jupiter to Europa Junction
rows.note: puts The Limbo Theorem in your Codex

conditions: The quest refuses to start until The Archwing quest is complete; building an Archwing without finishing it does not count.
The quest cannot be replayed. A sold part blueprint costs 25,000 Cephalon Simaris standing to replace.
bonuses: The Circuit skips this whole gate: Limbo is a week 6 pick, with Neuroptics at tier 2, Chassis at tier 5, Systems at tier 8 and the main blueprint at tier 10.

conditions: The quest never gives the main blueprint. The Market tile shows 200 platinum for the built frame; click the tile and use the separate Blueprint button, which costs credits.

groups.activity: Archwing Interception, kill enemies and pick up Proof Fragments
groups.meta: one run can cover all three

rows.label: Proof Fragment
rows.note: 1 per Theorem key; the keys cost 6,500 cr each

conditions: Winning the Interception gives nothing; the kills are the point, and not every kill drops a fragment.
Some enemies fly outside the mission area. Chasing them forces an abort, so let them despawn.
The game never says you have enough fragments. Check the Foundry.
bonuses: Clanmates and recruit chat often hold spare fragments, which skips the Interception entirely.

disclosures.title: loadout
disclosures.body: The Interception is trivial with levelled Archwing gear and painful with an unmodded rank 3 Odonata. The Elytron and the Itzal were named as comfortable picks.

groups.place: CAMBRIA EARTH, MARTIALIS MARS, OSE EUROPA
conditions: The blueprints drop only while you are on the quest. Joining someone else's run of the same node gives nothing.
Order is Theorem key, then Excavation, three times. Power Carrier spawn waits are the common complaint.
bonuses: A frame that protects the extractors and clears fast helps; Frost was named.
